en: Psalms 135

p.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,

en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
u.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,

en:
135:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
135:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

en: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
u.src: 2  you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

p.src: 3  Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

en: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
u.src: 3  Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

en: 135:3 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 4  For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

en: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
u.src: 4  For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

en: 135:4 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 5  For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

en: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
u.src: 5  For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

p.src: 6  Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

en: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
u.src: 6  Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

p.src: 7  He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

en: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.
u.src: 7  He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

p.src: 8  He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

en: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
u.src: 8  He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

p.src: 9  He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

en: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
u.src: 9  He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

p.src: 10  He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

en: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—
u.src: 10  He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

p.src: 11  Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

en: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—
u.src: 11  Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

p.src: 12  and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

en: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
u.src: 12  and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

p.src: 13  Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.

en: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.
u.src: 13  Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.

p.src: 14  For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

en: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
u.src: 14  For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

p.src: 15  The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

en: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
u.src: 15  The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

p.src: 16  They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

en: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
u.src: 16  They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

p.src: 17  They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

en: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.
u.src: 17  They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

p.src: 18  Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

en: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.
u.src: 18  Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

p.src: 19  House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!

en: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!
u.src: 19  House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!

p.src: 20  House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!

en: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!
u.src: 20  House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!

p.src: 21  Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

en: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 21  Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

en: 135:21 Hebrew: יה Yah
